What a bite does

Bites stop the blood from clotting, and some damage muscle or cause mild paralysis such as drooping eyelids. In 24 confirmed cases in 2004-2008, everyone survived with treatment.

Antivenom source. Tiger snake antivenom.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
